tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground (the deck's slide ground). Dark value is the deck's ink used as a ground; derived pairing, not in the deck.

tokens.name: canvas-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: code blocks, terminal chrome, the snippet box on a white surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards on canvas; the ground of the light README banner and social art so they sit flush on GitHub. Dark value derived.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: A card on surface, bounded by line. Never stacked further.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders, exactly the deck's card stroke. Decorative: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and rules that carry meaning. 3.5:1 on canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, the wordmark, the monochrome mark. 16:1 on white. Dark value derived.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running text (the deck's body colour). 10.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on canvas and surface; 5.7:1 or better. Dark value derived.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, the $ prompt, snapback.run under the lockup. FLAG: 3.5:1 on light grounds, the deck's own value kept exact; use at 19px bold or larger, or as a non-text mark. Dark value derived (6.1:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Snapback's identity colour, the deck's dark green: the mark's block, favicons, ANSI green, the app-icon block. Same hex in both themes. 5.1:1 on white so it also works as text; 3.2:1 on the dark canvas, which is enough for a mark but not for body text there (use accent-text).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Green as text: .snapshot in snippets, success words. Equals accent on light (5.1:1 on white; 4.5:1 on accent-soft); the dark value is a derived light green (8.2:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for a highlighted line or a success callout (the deck's green panel). Text on it: ink or accent-text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (5.1:1 on #1e7e43). On accent-hover use ink instead.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Interactive colour in docs and the web UI: links, primary buttons, selected states, eyebrow labels, as in the deck. FLAG: 4.5:1 on white, 4.3:1 on canvas; keep link text on surface. Dark value is the deck's light-blue tint.

tokens.name: blue-alt
tokens.usage: Blue hover and the numbered step badges. Not for text under 19px.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for an information panel (the deck's blue panel). Text on it: ink, ink-body or blue at 19px+ bold.

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: Decorative blue: the arc of a large background shape, chart fills, never text.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Caution as a fill, badge or icon. Never text on light grounds (1.9:1).

tokens.name: yellow-text
tokens.usage: Caution as text: 4.7:1 on white; 4.3:1 on yellow-soft (FLAG, the deck's pair kept exact).

tokens.name: yellow-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for a caution panel (the deck's yellow panel). Text on it: ink, ink-body or yellow-text.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, as an icon, border or bold text 19px+. FLAG: 3.9:1 on white, the deck's value kept exact; body-size error text is ink with an error: prefix.

tokens.name: ghost
tokens.usage: The earlier-version outline and arc when the mark is drawn tonally at display sizes. 3.5:1 on canvas; not for text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of a glass panel (snippet boxes, cards, sheets). Always over a canvas that carries a glass-tint so there is something to refract; pair with backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.4) in CSS.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: 1px inner light edge of a glass panel, drawn inset 0.5px.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px outer edge of a glass panel, on its exact bounds.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Top of the specular highlight gradient on a glass panel; fades to transparent by 45% of its height.

tokens.name: glass-tint-green
tokens.usage: Soft radial disc behind glass, fading to transparent at its edge. Equals accent-soft; listed so the ground is deliberate.

tokens.name: glass-tint-blue
tokens.usage: The second, smaller disc behind glass. Equals blue-soft. Never more than three discs on one surface.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark: IBM Plex Sans SemiBold, lowercase, -0.8% tracking. Ship the outlined SVG; set live only in the CLI's web UI header.

styles.name: wordmark-alt
styles.usage: Alternate wordmark for a more literal CLI voice (JetBrains Mono ExtraBold). One or the other per surface, never both.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The pitch line and first paragraph of a page.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text in docs and the web UI.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels and captions. Lowercase or sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and code blocks in docs; the snippet in social art at 20-21px.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Paths and timestamps in dense tables.

styles.name: prompt
styles.usage: The command in a snippet when it should carry weight; the $ stays code in ink-faint.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline padding, between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Snippet box vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Snippet box horizontal padding; between sections in a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing in docs.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Clear space around the mark at display sizes equals one block side, which is about this at a 120px lockup.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Outer margins of the README banner.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Outer margins of the 1280x640 social preview.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The mark and colour blocks: the brand is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code chips, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Glass panels, snippet boxes, buttons. Glass wants a rounder corner than the deck's 8px cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill chips in the web UI, as in the deck's layer rows.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The exported app-icon tile only. Do not round the mark itself.

shadow.note: Shadows exist only under glass panels. Flat cards use line, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Under every glass panel; nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-glass-sm
tokens.usage: Under small glass chips such as the inline command in the README banner.
